note: Directives for the Japanese seat of the Eastern Solomons, 24 August 1942. Written for the game in its own words: these are not historical documents and quote none. Each gives the situation as the commander above has it and the mission with its purpose, and nothing the commander can find out for himself: what the enemy has, what is coming and what cannot be replaced are read elsewhere on the table. Decision 0157.

parts.heading: 1. Situation
text: Reinforcements are on passage to Guadalcanal. Enemy carriers are believed to be operating east of the island and are the chief danger to the movement. Their position is not known.
The detachment with Ryujo is assigned to you to strike the enemy airfield at Lunga Point.

parts.heading: 2. Mission
text: Destroy the enemy carriers east of Guadalcanal, and keep your own carriers in action, to clear the way for the reinforcement of the island.

parts.heading: 3. Execution
text: Employ the forces assigned to your command as you judge necessary. The method is yours.
The day is short. Find him before he finds you.
